messages:
sam: Dropping a compact thread: focused UX decisions for the latency card on narrow dashboards. Want final call on sampling control, keyboard-first heatmap, and abbrev labels.
nora: Nice. List the decisions so we can vote.
sam: 1) sampling UI: presets-only dropdown vs presets + hidden advanced slider. 2) heatmap a11y for canvas rendering (DOM mirror vs full-SVG). 3) legend/label abbrev rules at <420px. 4) small caption sparkline vs no sparkline.
diego: My vote: presets + an "Advanced" item that reveals a compact slider (keyboard accessible). For discoverability, show a tiny "custom" badge when custom value is active.
jin: For canvas accessibility, prefer the DOM mirror approach but only mount it when keyboard or screen reader is detected (avoid perf regression). Mirror cells should be offscreen but focusable.
lisa: Agreed on mirror. ARIA details: role="grid" on the mirror container; each cell role="gridcell" with aria-label like "Bucket 4/12: 62 reqs, p95 198 ms". Debounce SR updates until 250ms after user stops moving the scrubber.
sam: Abbrev rules proposal: at widths <420px show bucket labels without units ("<50", "50-100") and show unit once in legend header: "Latency 91ms" (sorry show as "Latency — ms"). Tooltip always shows full unit.
diego: Also propose adding a tiny inline sparkline in the card caption (10px tall) that shows recent p95 trend. It helps quick scan. On narrow widths it becomes a collapsed dot: click to expand.
jin: Accessibility for sparkline: mark decorative svgs aria-hidden="true" and provide a text alternative summary e.g., "p95 trend: rising over last 15m" in a visually hidden element.
lisa: Keyboard shortcuts: T opens timepicker, Shift+T toggles pin for focused card, S opens sampling presets. Make them configurable in prefs and show in ? help. Ensure they don't conflict with browser shortcuts.
sam: Pin semantics: per-panel per-user by default. Add a dashboard-level "Sync ranges" toggle in the header for ephemeral session sync (not persisted). Visual: small filled pin + dashed top border and tiny label "synced" when active.
diego: Backend notes: default heatmap sample=5% for orgs over threshold; API param remains sample_rate. Add /api/v1/baselines?metric=latency&mode=prev for dashed overlay.
lin: (product) microcopy tweak: change "sample rate" label to "Data sample" to reduce confusion. Use short hover "p95: 214 ms" and SR-friendly long form "95th percentile latency: 214 milliseconds" on focus.
lisa: Motion/accessibility: respect prefers-reduced-motion and user pref. If reduced-motion, disable smooth scrubber easing. Also ensure the focus halo is 3:1 contrast above background token outline-focus-3.
sam: Implementation detail: lazy-mount DOM mirror only when keyboard focus enters the card or when user has a11y pref. That keeps canvas perf fast for mouse-only users.
diego: For the custom slider, cap min at 1% and warn if user sets <2% with a small tooltip "very low sample may miss signals". Default preset label: "Data sample: 5% (org default)" if org policy applies.
sam: Final calls? presets+advanced slider, DOM mirror lazy-mount, abbrev labels at <420px with unit in legend, caption sparkline optional collapsed on narrow, pin per-user + session sync toggle. Anyone opposed?
nora: lgtm.
jin: lgtm.
lisa: lgtm.
design-bot: Sam uploaded updated frames -> https://redwood.app/figma/compact-latency-sparkline-sampler.
